files.README.md:
# mongoswift-mongodb-from-documents

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories and services with MongoKitten, in Swift with async/await. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no type for.
- Services: take and return the entities; updates take a Patch per field: .absent, or set to a value that may be nil.
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/AppDatabase.swift   the connection of DATABASE_URL
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/Bson.swift          values of documents, and what changed in one
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/UnitOfWork.swift    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/Errors.swift        DomainError: notFound, conflict, validationFailed; no HTTP codes
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/Entities/          one entity per collection
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/Repositories/      the repositories of each table
Sources/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocuments/Services/          one service per table
Tests/MongoswiftMongodbFromDocumentsTests/            repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json                     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mongodb://localhost:27017/app" swift test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

import Foundation

/// The values of a Customer that change: fields left .absent keep their value; .set(nil) empties one.
public struct CustomerChanges: Sendable {
    public var email: Patch<String?>
    public var name: Patch<String?>
    public var age: Patch<Int?>
    public var balance: Patch<Decimal?>
    public var visits: Patch<Int?>
    public var rate: Patch<Double?>
    public var active: Patch<Bool?>
    public var address: Patch<Customer.Address?>
    public var tags: Patch<[String]?>
    public var seen: Patch<Date?>
    public var ref: Patch<UUID?>
    public var photo: Patch<Data?>
    public var scores: Patch<BsonValue?>
    public var mixed: Patch<BsonValue?>
    public var nothing: Patch<BsonValue?>
    public var empty: Patch<[BsonValue]?>
    public var deletedAt: Patch<Date?>

    public init(email: Patch<String?> = .absent, name: Patch<String?> = .absent, age: Patch<Int?> = .absent, balance: Patch<Decimal?> = .absent, visits: Patch<Int?> = .absent, rate: Patch<Double?> = .absent, active: Patch<Bool?> = .absent, address: Patch<Customer.Address?> = .absent, tags: Patch<[String]?> = .absent, seen: Patch<Date?> = .absent, ref: Patch<UUID?> = .absent, photo: Patch<Data?> = .absent, scores: Patch<BsonValue?> = .absent, mixed: Patch<BsonValue?> = .absent, nothing: Patch<BsonValue?> = .absent, empty: Patch<[BsonValue]?> = .absent, deletedAt: Patch<Date?> = .absent) {
        self.email = email
        self.name = name
        self.age = age
        self.balance = balance
        self.visits = visits
        self.rate = rate
        self.active = active
        self.address = address
        self.tags = tags
        self.seen = seen
        self.ref = ref
        self.photo = photo
        self.scores = scores
        self.mixed = mixed
        self.nothing = nothing
        self.empty = empty
        self.deletedAt = deletedAt
    }
}
